title: Mango (Raw-Ripe): modeled ₹694/qtl left, Perumbavoor → Athirampuzha
summary: July 2024: reported mango (Raw-Ripe) prices at Perumbavoor and Athirampuzha imply a positive modeled margin after costs on 100% of 25 matched days; a morning-report back-test averages ₹694 per quintal. No actual trade verified.
why_selected: Selected from 86 same-variety market pairs screened for mango (Raw-Ripe) in July 2024; best tested candidate among the bounded set of routed finalists, not a global optimum.

evidence.observations: daily modal prices for the same variety and grade (Mango - Raw-Ripe, FAQ) at both markets; sale matched to the first Athirampuzha report 1–3 days after purchase
caveats: Back-test on reported prices: no actual shipment, buyer or seller is claimed.
Modal prices are reported daily aggregates, not offers anyone could be sure to get.
This data has no arrival volumes, so it cannot show whether the destination could absorb more supply; no capital-constrained or volume allocation optimum is claimed.

Costs extrapolate onion survey values (including to other crops) plus stated allowances, not freight quotes; OSRM car routing, not a verified truck route. Representative town points may not be at mandi gates.
Historical: this says what paid then, not what pays today.

scenes.headline: July 2024
scenes.caption: Perumbavoor (Kerala) and Athirampuzha (Kerala) both reported mango (Raw-Ripe) prices for the same variety and grade (Mango - Raw-Ripe, FAQ) on 25 matched days.

scenes.headline: Two markets, two prices
scenes.caption: Perumbavoor reported a median ₹4,000 per quintal. Athirampuzha reported a median ₹5,800 around modeled arrival days. These are not offers.

scenes.headline: Gap ₹900/qtl
scenes.caption: The median gap was ₹900 per quintal, and Athirampuzha was dearer on 100% of days.

scenes.headline: 64 km by road
scenes.caption: 64 km on OpenStreetMap roads (~1 hours by car). A loaded truck is slower, so we allow 1 days plus 7 days to get paid.

scenes.headline: After modeled costs
scenes.caption: Freight ≈₹14/qtl, 5% fees and commission, loading, 5% loss and interest. On the typical day ₹472 per quintal was left.

scenes.headline: Still positive under stress
scenes.caption: With 25% dearer freight, 10% loss and costlier credit, the typical day still kept ₹247 per quintal.

scenes.headline: A trader who only knew the morning's news
scenes.caption: Using only the latest available Athirampuzha report, the rule selects 25 of 25 modeled shipping days. 25 had positive modeled net, averaging ₹694 per quintal (₹424 under stress).

scenes.headline: The back-test
scenes.caption: The modeled Mango (Raw-Ripe) route from Perumbavoor to Athirampuzha was positive on 100% of matched days in July 2024. At that average, a 100-quintal (10-tonne) load implies ₹69,400, or ₹42,400 under stress. Actual buyer, capacity, haggling, rejection and delays are unknown.

assumptions.value: onion survey freight applied per quintal to mango (Raw-Ripe)
scaled by road km against the 1,115 km Lasalgaon→Azadpur route → ₹14/qtl here
12% a year (14% adverse) for transit + 7 days
~450 road km a day → 1 days here

conclusion: The modeled Mango (Raw-Ripe) route from Perumbavoor to Athirampuzha was positive on 100% of matched days in July 2024. At that average, a 100-quintal (10-tonne) load implies ₹69,400, or ₹42,400 under stress. Actual buyer, capacity, haggling, rejection and delays are unknown.

sources.title: Agmarknet / data.gov.in daily mandi modal prices (retained AGRINET snapshot)
